source.section: II.P.3.a (PDF p.16; printed page not confirmed)
source.quote_free_summary: A competitor who fails to report to the Floor Coordinator on time or fails to answer the Floor Coordinator's calls for a heat is disqualified from that dance category.

requirement: Disqualification from the dance category for a late or unanswered report is NOT IMPLEMENTED for a future UCWDC profile. Studio No-show is not a substitute for UCWDC compliance.
enforcement_point: Not built. NOT IMPLEMENTED; a blocker for activating the corresponding future governing-body profile. Studio/Custom behavior is unchanged.
interpretation_notes: The coordinator cites printed p.39; the extracted text has no printed page numbers, so only PDF p.16 is confirmed.
